problem_statement: Prevent Proxy-Authorization from leaking to HTTPS destinations after redirects while retaining HTTP proxy authorization, tunnel authentication and ordinary redirect metadata.
notes: The reference patch is the upstream implementation change under Apache-2.0; LICENSE.upstream and NOTICE.upstream preserve its notices.
The original MIT-licensed evaluation oracle uses an in-memory recording transport and published dummy proxy credentials; it performs no network requests.
The selected 61-case suite covers structures, hooks and proxy behavior; it is not the full Requests suite.
